blind.description: A stylized fantasy/medieval archery target made of a thick woven straw boss mounted on a rustic wooden A-frame easel stand. The face of the target has a light cream border stitched to the straw, an outer red ring, and an orange/yellow bullseye center. Three wooden arrows with off-white fletchings are stuck into the front face. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with hand-painted textures, standing naturally on four wooden support legs without any base plinth.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a thick circular straw pad mounted against a wooden angled support stand on the left, with three arrow shafts projecting out toward the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 feet wide.
